automated.summary: SCHED-6 makes every scheduled (autonomous) tool denial terminal so a job never silently degrades to another tool. Falsifiers cover: the autonomous non-promptable denial is terminal and interrupts the run; a declared-but-ungranted grantable denial raises the one-tap approval card and approving grants the agent; an under-declared grantable denial one-tap approve-and-declares (adds the job requirement AND grants) for both browser and scoped RunCommand; non-grantable denials (locked/fixed-image/protected/unmatched/mcp) stay a legible instruction-only card; a denied tool cancels a concurrent side-effecting sibling and the shell launch is fenced after async approval; the first parallel denial is sticky; the requirement append runs only after the grant commits and settles/resumes even when the append loses its CAS or throws; the Anthropic legacy denial format's grantability is preserved through the parser; and DeepAgents pre-check denials (protected/memory/yolo-denylist) route through the terminal handler on scheduled runs.
